# Indigo Blueprint

Drafting-table indigo on cool white. Reads as a plan rather than a pitch: precise, gridded, unsentimental.

## Color Palette

- **Base — drafting indigo**: `#1b2a6b` — titles, drawing labels
- **Surface — cool white**: `#f4f6fb` — page or slide background
- **Body — graphite line**: `#1e2233` — running text and annotations
- **Accent — signal blue**: `#3d53c4` — dimensions, callouts, highlighted paths

## Typography

- **Headers**: Franklin Gothic Medium
- **Body Text**: Segoe UI

## Best Used For

Engineering designs, migration plans, system diagrams, technical specifications and roadmaps.
